description: Processing-time estimate for one programme (by id) or all programmes: the typical government processing range, the basis of the estimate and its source. id.description: Programme id as returned by list_programmes (e.g. "dominica-cbi", "greece-gv", "portugal-gv"). Not a country name and not a website slug.
